_ghi_chu: English text for the field paths (en/lo-trinh-nganh.html). Same ids and step order as data/lo-trinh-nganh.json, which holds the video numbers. tu_khoa here are English keywords, added to the Vietnamese ones. ngach is a list in the same order as data/lo-trinh-nganh.json.
nhom: Use AI in your own work and life

moi-bat-dau.chao: Welcome! We start with the easiest part: what AI is, trying it for the first time, and the traps to avoid.

buoc.mo_ta: The two opening videos, then what AI is really doing when it guesses words.
AI makes things up with confidence, forgets in long chats, and what never to paste into it.
The 4-part prompt formula and three of the most useful tips.
Deepfakes, voice-clone calls and a family password.
The AI map in 90 seconds, 10 common myths and a 4-week self-study path.

van-phong.chao: Office work is where AI takes on the most: Excel, email, meetings, reports. Follow this order.

buoc.mo_ta: The 4-part prompt, where AI makes things up, and what data you must never paste into AI.
Excel formulas in plain words, meeting summaries, slides from an outline, long emails and translating documents.
Weekly reports, SOPs, feedback for colleagues, project milestones and reading customer feedback.
Teach AI who you are, keep a prompt library and let AI handle repeat jobs.

buoc.ten: Hand tasks to an AI agent
buoc.mo_ta: Which tasks you can hand over, writing a clear brief and setting guardrails.

giao-vien.chao: Teachers, AI drafts lesson plans, tests and comments fast, and you keep the final say. Here's the path.

buoc.mo_ta: The 4-part prompt and why you check everything AI writes.
Lesson plans, tests at several levels, comments on work, mixed-level classes, AI detectors.
Turn videos and lectures into exercises and let AI quiz students back.
Virtual labs, role-play and branching scenarios.
Teach kids to double-check AI and spot made-up citations.

hoc-sinh.chao: Use AI to really learn, not to copy homework. This path is for you.

buoc.mo_ta: AI guesses words, AI makes things up, and the 4-part prompt.

buoc.ten: Study with AI the right way
buoc.mo_ta: Reading long documents, oral exam practice, essays without plagiarism, speaking practice.
Study mode and interactive learning: doing beats watching.
New words in context, emails, interviews and reading English news.
A bilingual CV, LinkedIn and mock interviews with AI.

gia-dinh.ten: I'm a parent looking after my family
gia-dinh.chao: The whole family can enjoy AI and stay safe: kids learning, grandparents avoiding scams, lighter housework.

buoc.ten: Know enough to guide your kids
buoc.mo_ta: What AI is, where it makes things up and what not to paste into it.
Homework with AI, teaching kids to double-check, four house rules.
Bedtime stories, chains of why-questions and word games with things at home.

buoc.ten: Stop scams for the whole family
buoc.mo_ta: Cloned voices of relatives, a family password, helping grandparents, fake QR stickers.
Cooking from the fridge, shopping on a budget, a lower power bill.

ban-hang.ten: I sell online or run a shop
ban-hang.chao: Shop owners are busy, so we start with videos that make money or save hours.

buoc.mo_ta: The 4-part prompt and which customer data you must never paste into AI.
Product descriptions, photos, livestream scripts, answering messages and reading reviews.
A 9-step walkthrough: analyze a real sales file with AI, sample file included.
Job posts, fair CV screening, a staff handbook, shift planning.
Ideas from customer questions, 30-second scripts, titles and a posting calendar.

tim-viec.ten: I'm job hunting or changing careers
tim-viec.chao: AI is changing how many jobs work. See which tasks AI takes first, which skills keep their value and how to job hunt in the AI era.

buoc.mo_ta: AI replaces tasks, not jobs; which tasks go first; skills that keep their value.
Job hunting in the AI era and a 90-day plan.
Bilingual CV, LinkedIn, mock interviews, salary talks and your first 30 days.
Emails and interviews in English with AI.
Want to move into data? Start with Data Analysis.

noi-dung.chao: Creators use AI to move faster and still sound like themselves. Here's your path.

buoc.ten: Write with AI in your own voice
buoc.mo_ta: Teach AI your writing style, social posts, thank-you notes and proofreading.
Ideas, 30-second scripts, titles, subtitles, a posting calendar and reading channel stats.
How AI draws, images from a description, cards and posters.
AI turning text into speech and making video from one sentence.
Is AI art copyrighted, and how to spot AI-made content.

hieu-sau.ten: I want to understand how AI works inside
hieu-sau.chao: Curious about the inside? We open it layer by layer: tokens, attention, AI learning from mistakes, then the systems behind it.

buoc.mo_ta: Tokens, embeddings, attention, pretraining, RLHF, temperature, RAG, reasoning.
Knobs, loss, gradient descent, backpropagation, overfitting, scaling.

buoc.ten: From one AI to a team
buoc.mo_ta: Tool calling, MCP and multi-agent systems.
Cloud, guardrails, evaluation, logging and monitoring.
The AI × 8 branches series: each branch adds a piece, ending with AGI.

da.ten: I want to be a Data Analyst
da.chao: Data Analysis starts in Excel. The whole series uses one real bubble tea sales file you can download and follow part by part.

buoc.mo_ta: The 4-part prompt and asking AI for Excel formulas in plain words.
Analyze a sales book in 9 steps, sample file included.
8 parts: reading the file, cleaning, pivot tables, SUMIFS and XLOOKUP, IQR, fair comparisons, charts, dashboards.
Misleading numbers and charts, reading hundreds of customer comments.
Check every number the AI writes.

ds.ten: I want to be a Data Scientist
ds.chao: Data Science is predicting with data, and measuring how good the prediction is. We go from Python to a real forecast.

buoc.mo_ta: Machines learning from examples, and what overfitting is.
Walkthrough: predict how many cups sell tomorrow.
Watch the Data Analysis series first to get to know the bubble tea file.
8 parts: pandas, EDA, sold-out days, baseline and MAE, RandomForest, quantiles, a weekly plan.
Classifying customers who leave, precision and recall, cross-validation.
Measure embeddings against keywords before you trust them.

de.ten: I want to be a Data Engineer
de.chao: Data engineers build the pipes that keep data flowing every night. You'll go from 183 CSV files to a database that runs itself.

buoc.mo_ta: What RAG is: why AI needs clean, fresh data.
The first two parts of Data Analysis: reading and cleaning the file.
8 parts: schema, extract and transform, loading without duplicates, SQL, incremental loads, data quality, cron.
Continue into DevOps: git, Docker and CI/CD for the pipeline.
A fresh data pipeline for RAG.

devops.ten: I want to work in DevOps
devops.chao: DevOps makes code run reliably beyond your laptop. We go from git to alerts and rollback.

buoc.mo_ta: Claude Code for people who don't code, and how to report bugs to AI.

buoc.ten: Know the pipeline you'll look after
buoc.mo_ta: The first part of the Data Engineering series.
8 parts: git, branches and pull requests, pytest, Docker, GitHub Actions, deploy, alerts and rollback.
Evaluation, logging and monitoring for an AI system.
LLMOps: prompts and eval questions kept in git.

cloud.ten: I want to work in Cloud
cloud.chao: Cloud is renting machines and services by the hour. The series uses AWS on a local emulator, so it costs nothing yet.

buoc.mo_ta: Cloud in an AI system, and what each question costs.

buoc.ten: Package before going to the cloud
buoc.mo_ta: Docker and deploy from the DevOps series.
8 parts: shared responsibility, IAM, S3, managed databases, Fargate, serverless, security, cost.
Put an AI assistant online with keys, limits and billing.

ml.ten: I want to learn Machine Learning
ml.chao: Machine learning is teaching machines from examples. The series predicts which customers are about to leave, using scikit-learn.

buoc.mo_ta: What machine learning is, recommendation algorithms, overfitting.
Loss, gradient descent, memorizing versus understanding.
Walkthrough: predict tomorrow's cups with Python.
8 parts: features, train/test split, precision and recall, regression, overfitting, cross-validation, clustering.
Train your own or use an existing model.

dl.ten: I want to learn Deep Learning
dl.chao: Deep learning is many-layer neural networks, the engine under today's AI. You'll teach a camera to recognize 6 kinds of cups with PyTorch.

buoc.mo_ta: AI looking at images, tokens and embeddings.
The whole 7-part series: from knobs to looking inside the black box.
8 parts: tensors, neurons, loss, backprop, the training loop, CNNs, dropout, embeddings and GPUs.
Open up embeddings, train a neural network.

robotics.chao: Robotics is AI stepping into the real world. You'll build a virtual robot in Python that carries bubble tea, from sensors to path finding.

buoc.mo_ta: How LiDAR works, humanoid robots and self-driving cars.
Practice in a virtual world before the real one.
8 parts: sensors and noise, kinematics, PID, EKF, maps and A*, avoiding obstacles, safety.
AI gives orders, a drink robot with a closed loop and safety rails.
